opportunities.description: The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.
